title: Lixity — local manuscript analysis and research workbench for authors
description: Lixity is a local workspace for writing and revising manuscripts. Its browser app, CLI and Python API share a deterministic, offline analysis engine. It measures features such as sentence length, lexical diversity and words inside recognized quotations. Language profiles provide readability estimates and cues for reviewing possible tense changes. Authors can inspect counted passages, compare chapters or saved versions, and connect manuscript excerpts to retained sources and versioned dossiers. PDF and reading website exports include material the author selects. The measurements describe patterns in the supplied text and support editorial review. Language, software version and analysis settings determine which results are available.
notes: Deposited from a tagged GitHub release of the software.
